## Filling Missing Abstracts

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Script: filling_missing_abstracts.R
# Purpose: Retrieve and fill in missing abstracts in PubMed metadata
# Input:   data/raw/pubmed.rds — Dataset with PMIDs and possibly missing abstracts
# Output:  data/raw/pubmed.rds — Same dataset, with missing abstracts filled (if available)
# Dependencies: xml2, httr, dplyr
# ============================================================
```

```{r}
# Load local project-aware file path utility
library(here)

# Load dataset containing PubMed IDs (PMID)
data <- readRDS(here("data/raw/pubmed.rds"))

class(data)
str(data)
head(data)
```

```{r}
# Count missing titles and abstracts
missing_title <- sum(is.na(data$Title) | data$Title == "")
missing_abstract <- sum(is.na(data$Abstract) | data$Abstract == "")

cat("Missing Title count: ", missing_title, "\n")
cat("Missing Abstract count: ", missing_abstract, "\n")
```

```{r}
data <- readRDS(here("data/raw/pubmed.rds"))

# Extract PMIDs with missing abstracts
missing_pmid <- data$PMID[is.na(data$Abstract) | data$Abstract == ""]

# Ensure output folder exists
dir.create("data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Write missing PMIDs to file
writeLines(as.character(missing_pmid), "data/processed/missing_pmids.txt")
```

```{r}
library(xml2)   # for parsing PubMed API XML responses
library(httr)   # for making HTTP requests
library(dplyr)  # for data wrangling

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Function: fetch_abstract
# Purpose:  Retrieve abstract text from PubMed using PMID
# Input:    pmid — PubMed ID as character or numeric
# Output:   character string of abstract (or NA if not found)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
fetch_abstract <- function(pmid) {
  url <- paste0(
    "https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi",
    "?db=pubmed&id=", pmid,
    "&retmode=xml"
  )
  
  # Attempt to fetch and parse abstract from API
  res <- tryCatch(read_xml(GET(url)), error = function(e) NA)

  if (!is.na(res)) {
    abstract <- xml_text(xml_find_first(res, "//AbstractText"))
    return(abstract)
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

# Fill Missing Abstracts
data <- readRDS(here("data/raw/pubmed.rds"))
missing_idx <- which(is.na(data$Abstract) | data$Abstract == "")

for (i in seq_along(missing_idx)) {
  row <- missing_idx[i]
  pmid <- data$PMID[row]

  abs_text <- fetch_abstract(pmid)

  if (!is.na(abs_text)) {
    data$Abstract[row] <- abs_text
    cat(sprintf("[%d/%d] Filled PMID: %s\n", i, length(missing_idx), pmid))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("[%d/%d] Not found PMID: %s\n", i, length(missing_idx), pmid))
  }

  Sys.sleep(0.34)  # NCBI API rate limits
}
```

```{r}
# Save Updated Dataset
dir.create("data/raw", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(data, file = "data/raw/pubmed.rds")
cat("✅ All abstract filling tasks completed. Updated file saved.\n")
```
